neighbours.label: Indiana: the state (Indianapolis, Bloomington, South Bend, the Hoosiers) and the word 'Indiana' in any sense (Indiana Jones); Ohio, Illinois and Kentucky places stay low
fire: Race fans fill the speedway in Indianapolis every Memorial Day.
The fedora that Indiana Jones wore sold at auction.
Fans in South Bend packed the stadium for the rivalry game.
Across the state, Hoosiers take their high school basketball very seriously.
The limestone for the Empire State Building came from Bedford, Indiana.
Students at Purdue in West Lafayette design rockets.
A tornado touched down near Fort Wayne on Sunday.
Fields of corn surround the small towns of southern Indiana.

Fans in Columbus packed the stadium for the rivalry game.
Across the state, Buckeyes take their college football very seriously.
The marble for the Lincoln Memorial came from Marble, Colorado.
Students at the university in Champaign design rockets.
A tornado touched down near Louisville on Sunday.
Fields of corn surround the small towns of southern Illinois.
